title: What If the Sun Didn't Rise for Seven Weeks? Tromsø Knows

scenes.text: What if the Sun never rose for seven weeks? In Tromsø, Norway, that happens every winter.
The sun sets on November 27 and doesn't come back until January 15, about 49 days later.
But it isn't pitch black. The sky glows blue at midday, and streetlights and floodlit ski slopes stay on.
Tromsø sits at 69 degrees north, and people there report about 80 percent higher odds of sleep problems in winter.
Yet a study of 8,010 people found no significant seasonal difference in mental distress.
Seven weeks without sunrise hurts sleep, but it does not break people.
